رَبُّهُ is nominative and follows ٱجْتَبَاهُ as its explicit subject.
The suffix هُ on رَبُّهُ marks the possessor of رَبّ.
The suffix هُ on جَعَلَهُ is the object made.
ٱلصَّالِحِينَ is governed by مِنَ as the complement of جَعَلَهُ.
جَعَلَهُ is joined by فَ to ٱجْتَبَاهُ as the sequenced following action.
ٱلَّذِينَ is the nominative subject of يَكَادُ.
ٱلَّذِينَ is also the relative head whose صلة is كَفَرُوا.
يُزْلِقُونَكَ supplies the predicate of the near-action verb يَكَادُ.
The suffix كَ on يُزْلِقُونَكَ is the object they try to make slip.
أَبْصَارِهِمْ is governed by بِ as the instrument of يُزْلِقُونَكَ.
The suffix هِمْ on أَبْصَارِهِمْ marks whose eyes are meant.
لَمَّا سَمِعُوا ٱلذِّكْرَ gives the temporal setting for يُزْلِقُونَكَ.
ٱلذِّكْرَ is the accusative direct object of سَمِعُوا.
يَقُولُونَ is coordinated by وَ with the preceding hostile verbal action.
إِنَّهُ لَمَجْنُونٌ is the utterance governed by يَقُولُونَ.
The suffix هُ in إِنَّهُ is the noun governed by إِنَّ.
مَجْنُونٌ is the predicate of إِنَّهُ, reinforced by the lām.
ذِكْرٌ is the predicate of هُوَ under the مَا إِلَّا restriction.
ٱلْعَالَمِينَ is governed by لِّ as the complement of ذِكْرٌ.
